crossRefs.note: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for…
and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to…
wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.
A feast is made for laughter, and wine makes the life glad; and money is the answer for all things.

translations.web: “The vine said to them, ‘Should I leave my new wine, which cheers God and man, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’
translations.bsb: But the grapevine replied, ‘Should I stop giving my wine that cheers both God and man, to hold sway over the trees?’
translations.kjv: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
translations.asv: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my new wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to wave to and fro over the trees?
